caption: The drawing depicts a standing male figure, posed in profile facing left, with a muscular and bare upper torso. He is adorned with a headdress featuring long, multicolored feathers including green, red, blue, and yellow. On his back, there is a quiver also decorated with similarly colored feathers. The man is dressed in a garment that appears to be made of animal pelts, draped over his left shoulder and covering his lower body, leaving his right shoulder and upper torso exposed. He holds a long yellow bow in his right hand, which rests on the ground, and a brown object, possibly a cloak or additional garment, draped over his left forearm. The figure stands barefoot on a rectangular base that is shaded brown, with his weight shifting onto his right leg. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the figure and his attire.
title: Cigar Store Indian
